answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 41464 Country: Pakistan Title: I am Hafiz Quran. On 21st Ramadan I will be given my degree in my madrasa Question: I am Hafiz Quran. On 21st Ramadan I will be given my degree in my madrasa. But I want to sit in etikaf. In this condition can I go from mosque to madrasa to collect my degree? If so, will my etikaf remain sunnah or it will turn into nafl? Answer ID: 41464 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1681/1318/B=1433) May Allah accept your i’tikaf. In the state of i’tikaf one can go out of the mosque only for natural calls and Shariah needs, . It is not lawful to go out of the mosque only to collect the degree of Hifz; it is neither natural nor Shariah need. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
